summary: Hitman 1 entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Hitman 1
entries.definitive_edition: HITMAN World of Assassination with HITMAN 1 GOTY content and Sarajevo Six Campaign Pack

emulation.notes: No emulation needed. Use current World of Assassination patches, max graphics settings, and IOI online services for progression/challenges. Capture offline-only behavior separately if documenting what survives without servers.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC World of Assassination build with HITMAN 1 GOTY destinations, Patient Zero, bonus missions, and Sarajevo Six DLC

primary.version: HITMAN World of Assassination with HITMAN 1 GOTY content and Sarajevo Six Campaign Pack
primary.why: This entry refers to HITMAN (2016), the first World of Assassination season, not Hitman: Codename 47. The original 2016 release covered its initial platforms, while IO Interactive now makes World of Assassination the current unified route across platforms through the 2026 patch notes. On Windows, the current WOA build gives the highest capture/settings ceiling, and the Sarajevo Six Campaign Pack fills the old PS4-only mission gap.
primary.how_to_play: Install HITMAN World of Assassination on Windows, keep the game patched, and verify that HITMAN 1 GOTY destinations/content are available. Add the Sarajevo Six Campaign Pack for every HITMAN 1-era mission, and archive with online services available because progression, challenges, contracts, and live-service features depend on IOI services.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate this with Hitman: Codename 47, which is a separate 2000 game. Older standalone HITMAN 1 purchases were replaced by World of Assassination as the current storefront path in 2023. Preserve any run with clear notes about server-dependent challenges, contracts, unlocks, cross-progression, and live-service availability.

entries.title: Hitman 2
entries.definitive_edition: HITMAN World of Assassination on Windows with HITMAN 2 Standard and Expansion content

emulation.notes: No emulation needed. Use current WOA patches and IOI online services for progression/challenges.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC World of Assassination build with HITMAN 2 standard and expansion destinations

primary.version: HITMAN World of Assassination with HITMAN 2 Standard and Expansion content
primary.why: This row is HITMAN 2 (2018), the second World of Assassination season, not Hitman 2: Silent Assassin. The 2018 release covered PlayStation 4, Windows, Xbox One, and Stadia, while IO Interactive's 2023 consolidation makes World of Assassination the current route. Windows WOA is the highest-fidelity capture path, with the HITMAN 2 Expansion Pack needed for the full New York/Haven Island-era content set.
primary.how_to_play: Install HITMAN World of Assassination on Windows, keep it patched, and verify HITMAN 2 locations plus the HITMAN 2 Expansion Pack content are available. Use IOI online services for progression/challenges; document offline limitations separately if relevant.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate HITMAN 2 (2018) with Hitman 2: Silent Assassin (2002). Current storefront structure is World of Assassination, and server-dependent progression/challenges should be documented.

entries.title: Hitman 2 Christmas Game

primary.why: Hitman 2: Christmas Game is an Eidos promotional browser game made to promote Silent Assassin. No better or alternate platform route is known.
primary.how_to_play: Use a verified Flash preservation environment only if documenting promotional side material; do not treat this as a replacement or required route for Silent Assassin.

entries.remaster_caveats: Promotional side game for Silent Assassin; not a mainline Hitman entry or remake.

entries.title: Hitman 2 Silent Assassin
entries.definitive_edition: Original Windows PC release before v1.02 content edits; current GOG/Steam Windows releases are convenience alternatives

emulation.emulator: None for primary; PCSX2/Dolphin/Xemu only for console-version comparison
emulation.notes: Use native Windows for primary. If comparing ports, PS2, GameCube, and Xbox can be emulated, but those are not the definitive archive route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC, original content-preserving build where available

primary.version: Original Windows PC release, preferably pre-v1.02 for uncensored original content; GOG/Steam are convenient current PC routes with caveats
primary.why: Windows is an original release platform and gives the highest resolution/configuration ceiling. Since v1.02-era updates edited content, an original pre-v1.02 Windows build best preserves the original Gurdwara-related material when available; Steam and GOG are convenient current PC routes with compatibility/content caveats.
primary.how_to_play: For archive fidelity, use an owned original Windows retail build before the v1.02 content edits, then apply only compatibility fixes needed for capture. For convenience, use Steam or GOG and apply GOG support fixes or comparable compatibility patches such as renderer changes if launch/video issues appear.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate this 2002 sequel with HITMAN 2 (2018). HD Trilogy on PS3/Xbox 360 is a remastered compilation route, not a replacement for the original PC build. Some later PC and GameCube-era versions carry Sikh/Gurdwara content edits; document the exact executable/build used for capture.

entries.title: Hitman 3
entries.definitive_edition: HITMAN World of Assassination Deluxe Edition / Deluxe Pack on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use native PC for primary. Console/mobile/cloud routes should be captured only for platform comparison; Quest 3 VR Reloaded is standalone hardware-specific software.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC max settings, current WOA build

primary.version: HITMAN World of Assassination Deluxe Edition / Deluxe Pack, current PC build
primary.why: Windows is a launch platform for Hitman III, now also known as Hitman: World of Assassination. The current PC build has the highest capture ceiling, current WOA content hub, PC VR support, and PC-only ray tracing/adaptive-supersampling options. The Deluxe Pack/Deluxe Edition is the most complete route because it covers H3 Deluxe content, Seven Deadly Sins, and the H2 Expansion Access Pass.
primary.how_to_play: Install HITMAN World of Assassination on PC through a current storefront, then own/install the Deluxe Pack or equivalent Deluxe Edition entitlements for the extra campaign/DLC content. Stay online for progression, contracts, Freelancer/live content, and server-side features; document the build and owned DLC at capture time.

secondary.exclusive_content: HITMAN 3 VR: Reloaded is a standalone untethered VR version with dual-wielding, a new art style, overhauled VR UI, and movement/interactivity changes not represented by the flat PC primary.
secondary.what_to_play: Capture separately only if documenting the standalone VR rework; it is not the definitive route for the main World of Assassination archive.
secondary.why: XR Games and IOI released it as a new Meta Quest 3 VR version of HITMAN 3 with unique VR-specific features.

entries.remaster_caveats: Hitman III was renamed/reframed as Hitman: World of Assassination in 2023, folding HITMAN 1 and HITMAN 2 access into the same hub. Do not treat that as meaning every DLC is included without the Deluxe Pack. Stadia is discontinued. The Switch release is cloud-based. VR modes and HITMAN 3 VR: Reloaded should be documented as separate mode/platform notes because content, controls, and presentation differ from the flat PC route.

entries.title: Hitman Absolution
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release for campaign fidelity; Feral iOS/Android/Switch as secondary for active Contracts Mode

emulation.notes: Use native Windows for the primary. Console emulation is unnecessary for the archive route; capture Feral mobile/Switch ports only for Contracts Mode or portability comparison.

primary.version: Original Windows PC release, current Steam/GOG build with owned DLC/Professional content where available
primary.why: Windows is among the original 2012 release platforms, and the PC version has the highest resolution/settings/capture ceiling. The PS4/Xbox One HD Enhanced Collection runs up to 4K/60, but it remains a console remaster of the same game; the newer iOS, Android, and Switch ports are useful for active Contracts Mode but not the main fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam or GOG Windows release for the main campaign at max settings, documenting exact store/build and owned DLC. If the archive needs active Contracts Mode, capture the Feral iOS/Android/Switch version separately as a secondary route.

secondary.exclusive_content: Feral's 2026 updates restore active Contracts Mode with player-created assignments and cross-platform leaderboards on mobile and Switch.
secondary.what_to_play: After the PC campaign capture, use the Feral mobile or Switch version only if the archive needs current Contracts Mode behavior.
secondary.why: The original Absolution Contracts Mode servers were closed in 2018, while Feral's 2026 releases/updates explicitly add active Contracts support for mobile and Switch.

entries.remaster_caveats: HD Enhanced Collection on PS4/Xbox One is a 4K/60 remaster bundle with Blood Money, not a complete replacement for the PC route. Feral's mobile/Switch ports add modern controls and revived Contracts Mode, but they are separate lower-fidelity portability routes. Native Switch 2 support was announced as a 2026 free upgrade for Switch owners, but sources available on 2026-06-14 describe it as forthcoming rather than a released platform.

entries.title: Hitman Blood Money
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC original/current Steam or GOG build; Reprisal only as optional modernized-port comparison

emulation.notes: Use native Windows for primary. Console/mobile ports are for comparison only; no emulation is needed for the main archive route.

primary.version: Original Windows PC release, current Steam/GOG build
primary.why: Blood Money released on Windows, PlayStation 2, Xbox, Xbox 360, with later PS3/PS4/Xbox One HD routes, and Reprisal on mobile/Switch. Windows remains the best original-game archive route because it has the highest settings/capture ceiling; HD collections and Reprisal are useful comparison routes rather than replacements for native PC fidelity.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam or GOG Windows release for the main archive capture at max settings and document exact build/storefront. Capture Reprisal separately only if the archive wants the modern Instinct/minimap/control redesign.

entries.remaster_caveats: HD Trilogy and HD Enhanced Collection are remaster/compilation routes with console constraints. Reprisal is a redesigned mobile/Switch release with added assists inspired by later Hitman games, so it should not be treated as identical to the 2006 PC build.

entries.title: Hitman Blood Money L.A.
entries.definitive_edition: Original J2ME mobile build, preferably the highest-resolution preserved version

emulation.notes: Use a Java ME emulator with the preserved game file and match the intended screen resolution when possible.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original J2ME behavior, limited by preserved handset build

primary.version: Original Java mobile release by Morpheme/Eidos
primary.why: L.A. is a standalone Java/mobile follow-up to Blood Money Vegas, with no console or PC release. The only authentic platform is legacy mobile/J2ME; modern play is preservation through a compatible Java ME emulator.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally preserved `.jar`/`.jad` build on original compatible mobile hardware, FreeJ2ME, MicroEmulator, KEmulator, or J2ME Loader. Record the exact resolution build because J2ME games often shipped in multiple handset-specific variants.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is not the 2006 PC/console Blood Money and not Blood Money Vegas; it is a separate Java mobile title. Metadata is sparse and no public release references page was found, so confidence is medium despite multiple real sources.

entries.title: Hitman Blood Money Vegas
entries.definitive_edition: Original J2ME mobile build, preferably the highest-resolution preserved version

emulation.notes: Use a Java ME emulator with the preserved game file and match the intended screen resolution when possible.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original J2ME behavior, limited by preserved handset build

primary.version: Original Java mobile release by Morpheme/Eidos
primary.why: Vegas is a separate legacy mobile/J2ME adaptation tied to Blood Money, not the 2006 PC/console game. Only a mobile-phone/J2ME release exists, so an original mobile build is the primary.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally preserved `.jar`/`.jad` build on original compatible mobile hardware, FreeJ2ME, MicroEmulator, KEmulator, or J2ME Loader. Prefer the highest-resolution preserved build and document the exact handset profile.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is the separate mobile Blood Money Vegas adaptation, not the Las Vegas missions inside the 2006 PC/console Blood Money and not Blood Money L.A. Metadata is sparse and no public release references page was found, so confidence is medium.

entries.title: Hitman Codename 47
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC original/current Steam or GOG build

emulation.notes: Use native Windows. Compatibility wrappers or widescreen/FOV fixes may be useful; document them if applied.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC with documented compatibility fixes

primary.version: Original Windows PC release, current Steam/GOG build
primary.why: Hitman: Codename 47 released as a Windows-only title, and no completed console/remaster release exists as of 2026-06-14. The current Steam/GOG Windows route is therefore both the authentic and highest-fidelity released option.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam or GOG Windows release, then apply only documented compatibility/widescreen fixes as needed and record the exact build and any wrapper/fix used. Revisit after Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered releases in 2027.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate this 2000 original with HITMAN (2016). Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered was announced in June 2026 for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S in 2027 and includes Codename 47, but it is not a released platform route as of 2026-06-14.

entries.title: Hitman Contracts
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC original/current Steam or GOG build

emulation.notes: Use native Windows for primary. PCSX2/Xemu/PS3/Xbox 360 capture is optional only for port/remaster comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC with documented compatibility fixes

primary.version: Original Windows PC release, current Steam/GOG build
primary.why: Windows, PlayStation 2, and Xbox are original release platforms, and Windows has the highest settings/capture ceiling. HD Trilogy adds PS3/Xbox 360 routes, but they are console remasters rather than a better archive primary.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam or GOG Windows release, apply documented compatibility/widescreen fixes only as needed, and record exact build plus any wrapper/fix used. Use HD Trilogy only for console comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate this 2004 game, sometimes informally called Hitman 3, with HITMAN 3 (2021). Contracts remakes/revisits some Codename 47 material but is its own entry and not a substitute for the 2000 original. Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered was announced in June 2026 for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S in 2027, but it is not a released platform route as of 2026-06-14.

entries.title: Hitman Go
entries.definitive_edition: Hitman GO: Definitive Edition on Windows/Steam

emulation.notes: Use native Windows/Steam for primary. Mobile, Apple TV, VR, and Vita/PS4 routes are platform comparisons only.

primary.version: Hitman GO: Definitive Edition on Steam
primary.why: The mobile original, Definitive Edition, and VR Edition make up the release family. The Windows Definitive Edition on Steam is the cleanest capture route, with enhanced presentation and the complete non-mobile-IAP package.
primary.how_to_play: Buy/install Hitman GO: Definitive Edition on Steam for Windows and capture from the PC build. Use the original mobile release or VR Edition only for platform-specific comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: The original mobile release is the authentic touch-first version and includes mobile IAP/hint/unlock structures. Definitive Edition is enhanced for PC/console with the complete normal-play package and no mobile IAP. VR Edition is a separate presentation layer, not a content-complete replacement for the PC primary.

entries.title: Hitman Sniper
entries.definitive_edition: Current Hitman Sniper mobile build on iPad

emulation.notes: Use native iPad hardware. Android emulation is a fallback only and may not reflect touch-device presentation or store-service behavior.

primary.why: Android, iPhone, and iPad all received releases of the 2015 mobile game. The iPad route keeps the complete mobile content, current App Store availability, and a tablet presentation generally considered better than the smaller iPhone version.
primary.how_to_play: Install the current App Store version on an iPad/iPadOS device and capture from the tablet. Use Android only as an equivalent fallback if the iPad route is unavailable.

entries.remaster_caveats: The game is a mobile live-service style release with in-app purchases and updates; preserve the installed version used for capture because store builds can change.

entries.title: Hitman Sniper Challenge

emulation.notes: Native Windows is preferred. RPCS3/Xenia are only for comparing the PS3/Xbox 360 builds if needed.

primary.version: Steam Windows build / Hitman: Absolution package access
primary.why: PlayStation 3, Windows, and Xbox 360 are release platforms. The PC Steam app/package still exists, and Windows avoids the resolution limits of the PS3/Xbox 360 console versions and the modern compatibility caveats of the Mac build.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam Windows app if it is in the account library through Hitman: Absolution, Hitman Collection, or an old Sniper Challenge key. Capture on Windows at the highest stable resolution; the console builds are only preservation checks.

entries.remaster_caveats: Originally a preorder standalone mission for Hitman: Absolution and later included in Absolution/collection packages. Mac access exists but is not the preferred modern route because of 32-bit macOS compatibility limits.

entries.title: Hitman Sniper The Shadows

emulation.notes: Android emulation can only help inspect preserved client files; it does not restore the official live service. iOS archival footage/device capture is the cleaner documentation route.

primary.version: Final iOS live build, archival only
primary.why: The game released only on iPhone/iOS and Android. The game was delisted and shut down in January 2023, so the iPhone row is an archival reference pick rather than a currently playable recommendation; Android is equivalent content but not more complete.
primary.how_to_play: There is no current official way to play after the January 4, 2023 shutdown. For archival coverage, use preserved iOS footage or a pre-shutdown device/account capture if available; otherwise document the shutdown rather than replaying it through unofficial server claims.

entries.remaster_caveats: Delisted from App Store/Google Play on December 1, 2022 and shut down on January 4, 2023; do not treat current third-party APK listings as an official play route.
